intent: Advance the NovaPulse engine from Phase 2 to Phase 3 by implementing autonomous agent steering behaviors and swarm intelligence.
architecture_impact: Introduced a dedicated AI layer (steering and behaviors) and expanded the ECS component/system architecture to support autonomous entities, moving the engine from a purely physical simulation to an agent-driven swarm simulation.
